title: The Preserve at Corkscrew Estero FL: What Does the Guard at the Gate Actually Cost You? 2026
excerpt: About $498 per home per year — and it is not on your HOA bill. The Cypress Shadows CDD budget carries a Gatehouse category adopted at $219,500 for fiscal 2026 across 441 platted lots, including a security-personnel contract bigger than the district's lake and utility budgets combined.
